model_version: 2025 xteNCAM assessment under the 2023 framework; detailed report published as DFO Research Document 2026/026
notes: This is the newest production assessment represented here with detailed public inputs and outputs. Its research document was published in April 2026 and describes the assessment conducted in 2025. Its model input series end in 2024, while the assessment reports estimates for 2025. Recent landings by division and gear are transcribed from Research Document 2026/026 Table 1; summary SSB, recruitment, and mortality estimates are from Science Advisory Report 2025/043 Table 1. The full age/year survey, biological, and model-output series are not transcribed here.
